purpose: Verify that an authorized SysAdmin can trigger a manual backup
preconditions: Actor is authenticated with the SysAdmin role; BADMS is operational
action_or_input: SysAdmin submits a manual backup trigger request
expected_result: BADMS allows the trigger and initiates manual backup execution

purpose: Verify that an authorized Super Admin can trigger a manual backup
preconditions: Actor is authenticated with the Super Admin role; BADMS is operational
action_or_input: Super Admin submits a manual backup trigger request
expected_result: BADMS allows the trigger and initiates manual backup execution

purpose: Verify that an unauthorized actor without SysAdmin or Super Admin authority is denied from triggering a manual backup
preconditions: Actor is authenticated with a role other than SysAdmin or Super Admin (e.g., standard User, HoD, or IT Security)
action_or_input: Unauthorized actor attempts to trigger a manual backup
expected_result: BADMS denies the manual backup trigger and does not execute the backup

purpose: Verify that a submitted secure archival request is routed to the HoD of the requester's department
preconditions: User belonging to Department A has submitted a valid secure archival request in Submitted status
action_or_input: BADMS processes the submitted secure archival request for decision routing
expected_result: BADMS routes the secure archival request exclusively to the HoD of Department A

purpose: Verify that the HoD of the requester's department is authorized to decide on the secure archival request
preconditions: HoD of Department A is authenticated; a secure archival request from a Department A user is in Submitted status
action_or_input: Department A HoD submits an approval or rejection decision on the request
expected_result: BADMS authorizes and records the decision by the respective HoD

purpose: Verify that a HoD of a different department is prohibited from deciding the secure archival request
preconditions: HoD of Department B is authenticated; a secure archival request from a Department A user is in Submitted status
action_or_input: Department B HoD attempts to approve or reject the Department A archival request
expected_result: BADMS denies the decision action because the request does not belong to the HoD's department

purpose: Verify that a non-HoD actor is prohibited from deciding a secure archival request
preconditions: Actor without HoD role is authenticated; a secure archival request is in Submitted status
action_or_input: Non-HoD actor attempts to decide on the secure archival request
expected_result: BADMS denies the decision action

purpose: Verify that an authorized IT Security Team member can configure encryption for Sensitive data
preconditions: Actor is authenticated with the IT Security role; a secure archival request with authoritative classification Sensitive is routed for encryption configuration
action_or_input: IT Security Team member submits encryption configuration for the Sensitive data
expected_result: BADMS allows the encryption configuration by the IT Security member and proceeds with archive creation

purpose: Verify that a non-IT Security actor is prohibited from configuring encryption for Sensitive data
preconditions: Actor is authenticated with a role other than IT Security (e.g., SysAdmin or HoD); Sensitive data is routed for encryption
action_or_input: Non-IT Security actor attempts to configure encryption for the Sensitive data
expected_result: BADMS denies the encryption configuration request

purpose: Verify that an authorized SysAdmin can assign an authoritative classification (Critical, Sensitive, Routine, or Archival) to an HoD-approved secure archival request
preconditions: SysAdmin is authenticated; secure archival request has received HoD approval and is pending authoritative classification
action_or_input: SysAdmin selects and submits an authoritative classification (e.g., Critical, Sensitive, Routine, or Archival)
expected_result: BADMS permits the classification assignment and records the authoritative classification on the request

purpose: Verify that a non-SysAdmin actor is prohibited from assigning the authoritative secure-archival classification
preconditions: Actor is authenticated with a role other than SysAdmin (e.g., HoD, User, or IT Security); secure archival request has HoD approval
action_or_input: Non-SysAdmin actor attempts to assign the authoritative classification
expected_result: BADMS denies the authoritative classification assignment

purpose: Verify that authoritative classification assignment is prohibited prior to HoD approval
preconditions: SysAdmin is authenticated; secure archival request is in Submitted status and has not yet received HoD approval
action_or_input: SysAdmin attempts to assign authoritative classification before HoD approval has occurred
expected_result: BADMS denies the action because authoritative classification can only be assigned after HoD approval

purpose: Verify that restoration of data classified Sensitive is blocked until SysAdmin approval is recorded
preconditions: A restoration request for archived data classified Sensitive is submitted and pending SysAdmin approval
action_or_input: Technical restoration execution is attempted while SysAdmin approval is pending
expected_result: BADMS blocks the restoration execution until SysAdmin approval is explicitly recorded

purpose: Verify that restoration of Sensitive data is permitted to proceed once SysAdmin approval is recorded
preconditions: SysAdmin is authenticated; a restoration request for Sensitive data has received SysAdmin approval
action_or_input: Restoration execution proceeds following SysAdmin approval
expected_result: BADMS permits technical restoration of the Sensitive data to proceed

purpose: Verify that if SysAdmin rejects a Sensitive data restoration request, restoration is blocked and marked Rejected
preconditions: SysAdmin is authenticated; a restoration request for Sensitive data is pending approval
action_or_input: SysAdmin rejects the Sensitive restoration request
expected_result: BADMS records the request as Rejected and prevents restoration from proceeding

purpose: Verify that restoration of non-Sensitive data (Routine, Critical, Archival) follows the standard restoration path without requiring SysAdmin approval
preconditions: User has submitted a restoration request for archived data classified non-Sensitive (e.g., Routine)
action_or_input: BADMS processes the restoration request for the non-Sensitive data
expected_result: BADMS routes the request through standard restoration without requiring a SysAdmin approval step

purpose: Verify that when a user provides an explicit initial classification during secure archival upload, BADMS uses the provided classification
preconditions: User is authenticated and submits a secure archival upload
action_or_input: User submits upload data specifying an initial classification (e.g., Sensitive or Critical)
expected_result: BADMS accepts the request and sets the initial classification to the user-provided value

purpose: Verify that when a user omits the initial classification during secure archival upload, BADMS automatically assigns Routine as the default
preconditions: User is authenticated and submits a secure archival upload with the classification field omitted or empty
action_or_input: User submits upload data without specifying an initial classification
expected_result: BADMS assigns Routine as the default initial classification

purpose: Verify that data authoritatively classified Sensitive is encrypted using AES-256 both at rest and in transit
preconditions: Data has been authoritatively classified Sensitive; IT Security encryption configuration is initiated
action_or_input: BADMS creates the archive and stores/transfers the Sensitive data
expected_result: BADMS applies AES-256 encryption at rest in storage and enforces AES-256 encryption in transit during data transfer

purpose: Verify that archiving or transferring Sensitive data without AES-256 encryption is prohibited
preconditions: Data is classified Sensitive; encryption mechanism attempted is unencrypted or non-AES-256
action_or_input: BADMS evaluates encryption compliance before storing or transferring Sensitive data
expected_result: BADMS rejects storage or transmission without compliant AES-256 encryption

purpose: Verify that BADMS selects and applies institute retention policy rules based on the authoritative classification assigned to data
preconditions: Data has received an authoritative classification (e.g., Sensitive, Critical, Routine, or Archival)
action_or_input: BADMS evaluates data for retention policy assignment following classification
expected_result: BADMS associates the institute-defined retention rules corresponding to the assigned classification

purpose: Verify that distinct authoritative classifications receive their respective institute-defined retention treatments
preconditions: Two datasets exist with different authoritative classifications (e.g., one Critical and one Routine)
action_or_input: BADMS assigns retention policies to both datasets based on their respective classifications
expected_result: BADMS applies the Critical retention rules to the Critical dataset and the Routine retention rules to the Routine dataset without conflation

purpose: Verify that a submitted storage-extension request is routed for HoD approval
preconditions: A valid storage-extension request has been submitted by a user
action_or_input: BADMS processes the submitted storage-extension request
expected_result: BADMS routes the storage-extension request for HoD review and decision

purpose: Verify that a storage-extension request cannot be approved by a generic Admin or non-HoD actor
preconditions: A valid storage-extension request is submitted and pending approval; actor has a generic Admin or other non-HoD role
action_or_input: Generic Admin or non-HoD actor attempts to approve the storage-extension request
expected_result: BADMS denies the approval action; approval by a generic Admin is prohibited

purpose: Verify that storage extension is not granted without explicit HoD approval
preconditions: A storage-extension request is pending HoD decision
action_or_input: System or user attempts to apply storage extension before HoD approval is granted
expected_result: BADMS prevents quota extension from taking effect without recorded HoD approval

purpose: Verify that a HoD is permitted to act on archival requests, storage-extension requests, and reports belonging to the HoD's own department
preconditions: HoD of Department A is authenticated; requests and reports belong to Department A
action_or_input: HoD of Department A accesses reports and performs decisions on Department A archival and extension requests
expected_result: BADMS allows the HoD to access the reports and decide on the requests within their own department

purpose: Verify that a HoD is prohibited from deciding on a secure archival request belonging to a different department
preconditions: HoD of Department A is authenticated; secure archival request belongs to a user from Department B
action_or_input: Department A HoD attempts to approve or reject the Department B archival request
expected_result: BADMS denies the action due to departmental scope violation

purpose: Verify that a HoD is prohibited from deciding on a storage-extension request belonging to a different department
preconditions: HoD of Department A is authenticated; storage-extension request belongs to a user from Department B
action_or_input: Department A HoD attempts to approve or reject the Department B storage-extension request
expected_result: BADMS denies the action due to departmental scope violation

purpose: Verify that a HoD is prohibited from viewing operational or departmental reports belonging to a different department
preconditions: HoD of Department A is authenticated
action_or_input: Department A HoD attempts to access departmental reports for Department B
expected_result: BADMS denies access to Department B reports and preserves department isolation

purpose: Verify that a valid local backup schedule configured for a dataset overrides the institution-wide global backup schedule
preconditions: A valid local backup schedule exists for Dataset X; an institution-wide global backup schedule also exists
action_or_input: BADMS resolves the applicable backup schedule for Dataset X
expected_result: BADMS executes the backup according to the local schedule, overriding the global schedule

purpose: Verify that where no local backup schedule exists for a dataset, the institution-wide global backup schedule applies
preconditions: No local backup schedule exists for Dataset Y; an institution-wide global backup schedule is configured
action_or_input: BADMS resolves the applicable backup schedule for Dataset Y
expected_result: BADMS applies and executes the global backup schedule for Dataset Y

purpose: Verify that a new or modified backup schedule with valid parameters and no conflicts is successfully validated and applied
preconditions: Authorized administrator is authenticated; valid parameters (frequency, time, classification filters) with no schedule conflicts are provided
action_or_input: Administrator saves the valid backup schedule
expected_result: BADMS passes parameter and conflict validation, applies the schedule, and logs the configuration change

purpose: Verify that a backup schedule configuration with invalid parameters is rejected and the existing effective schedule is preserved
preconditions: Authorized administrator is authenticated; an existing effective backup schedule is in place
action_or_input: Administrator attempts to save a backup schedule containing invalid parameters (e.g., malformed frequency or time)
expected_result: BADMS rejects the schedule with validation errors and preserves the existing effective schedule unchanged

purpose: Verify that a backup schedule configuration with schedule conflicts is rejected and the existing effective schedule is preserved
preconditions: Authorized administrator is authenticated; an existing effective backup schedule is in place; new schedule parameters conflict with existing schedules or constraints
action_or_input: Administrator attempts to save a backup schedule with conflicting parameters
expected_result: BADMS detects the conflict, rejects the schedule change, and preserves the existing effective schedule

purpose: Verify that a scheduled automatic backup proceeds and executes successfully when the scheduled repository is reachable
preconditions: A scheduled backup is due; the scheduled repository is online and reachable
action_or_input: BADMS triggers scheduled backup execution at the due time
expected_result: BADMS verifies repository reachability, transfers eligible datasets to recovery storage, and records success

purpose: Verify that a scheduled automatic backup does not proceed and applies failure handling when the scheduled repository is unreachable
preconditions: A scheduled backup is due; the scheduled repository is offline or unreachable
action_or_input: BADMS attempts scheduled backup execution at the due time
expected_result: BADMS does not execute the backup, records backup status as Failed, and initiates failure handling

purpose: Verify that when a backup fails, BADMS sends an alert to the SysAdmin within the five-minute SLA window
preconditions: A manual or scheduled automatic backup execution fails, transitioning backup status to Failed
action_or_input: BADMS processes the backup failure event
expected_result: BADMS dispatches a backup-failure alert to the SysAdmin within five minutes of failure

purpose: Verify that the five-minute failure alert is not triggered when a backup completes successfully
preconditions: A backup completes successfully with status Success
action_or_input: BADMS records the successful backup completion
expected_result: BADMS does not trigger or send a backup failure alert

purpose: Verify that when one or two consecutive backup failures occur, escalation to the Director of IT is not triggered
preconditions: BADMS has recorded one or two consecutive backup failures (count < 3)
action_or_input: BADMS processes the 1st or 2nd consecutive failure
expected_result: BADMS alerts the SysAdmin per SLA, but does not send an escalation notification to the Director of IT

purpose: Verify that when three consecutive backup failures occur, BADMS escalates the condition to the Director of IT
preconditions: Two consecutive backup failures have occurred; a third consecutive backup execution fails
action_or_input: BADMS records the third consecutive backup failure (consecutive failure count reaches 3)
expected_result: BADMS sends an escalation notification to the Director of IT

purpose: Verify that a successful backup resets the consecutive failure counter so subsequent failures do not prematurely escalate to the Director of IT
preconditions: Two consecutive backup failures occurred, followed by a successful backup execution
action_or_input: A new backup failure occurs after the successful backup (consecutive failure count becomes 1)
expected_result: BADMS records the failure and alerts SysAdmin, but does not escalate to the Director of IT because the counter was reset

purpose: Verify that a storage-extension request is validated and accepted when the user's storage quota is full
preconditions: Authenticated user's current storage usage meets or exceeds the allocated quota (quota is full)
action_or_input: User submits a storage-extension request
expected_result: BADMS validates the usage condition, accepts the request, and routes it to the HoD

purpose: Verify that a storage-extension request is rejected or flagged as invalid when the user's storage quota is not full
preconditions: Authenticated user's current storage usage is below the allocated quota (quota is not full)
action_or_input: User submits a storage-extension request
expected_result: BADMS flags or rejects the request due to unmet usage conditions (quota not full) and does not submit it to HoD

purpose: Verify that the HoD reviews available storage infrastructure, departmental policies, and user justification to approve a storage-extension request
preconditions: A valid storage-extension request is pending HoD review; available infrastructure, departmental policy, and justification are presented to the HoD
action_or_input: HoD reviews the stated criteria and submits an Approved decision
expected_result: BADMS records the Approved decision based on the reviewed criteria and notifies the requester

purpose: Verify that the HoD reviews available storage infrastructure, departmental policies, and user justification to reject a storage-extension request
preconditions: A valid storage-extension request is pending HoD review; available infrastructure, departmental policy, and justification are presented to the HoD
action_or_input: HoD reviews the stated criteria (e.g., infrastructure shortfall or policy non-compliance) and submits a Rejected decision
expected_result: BADMS records the Rejected decision and notifies the requester

purpose: Verify that BADMS provides the required decision criteria (available storage infrastructure, departmental policies, and user justification) to the HoD during extension review
preconditions: A valid storage-extension request is in Submitted status pending HoD decision
action_or_input: HoD opens the storage-extension request review interface
expected_result: BADMS displays the user's justification, current usage and available infrastructure information, and departmental policy context

purpose: Verify that only the Super Admin can perform a special archival operation in BADMS following an offline request from an authority
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; a special archival request has been received offline from an authority
action_or_input: Super Admin initiates and executes the special archival operation within BADMS
expected_result: BADMS permits the special archival operation to the Super Admin, records the outcome, and requires no online HoD approval

purpose: Verify that a non-Super Admin actor is prohibited from performing the special archival operation in BADMS
preconditions: Actor is authenticated with a role other than Super Admin (e.g., SysAdmin, HoD, or standard User); an offline special archival request exists
action_or_input: Non-Super Admin actor attempts to perform the special archival operation in BADMS
expected_result: BADMS denies the operation; only Super Admin holds authority for this operation in BADMS

purpose: Verify that an offline requesting authority cannot directly execute the special archival operation in BADMS
preconditions: An external or offline authority originates a special archival request offline
action_or_input: Offline authority attempts direct execution of the special archival operation within BADMS without Super Admin mediation
expected_result: BADMS prohibits direct execution by the offline authority; only Super Admin can execute the operation in BADMS

purpose: Verify that only the Super Admin has authority to define and modify institution-wide global backup schedules and default backup policies
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated with highest authority for global backup configuration
action_or_input: Super Admin defines or modifies an institution-wide global backup schedule and default backup policy
expected_result: BADMS validates, accepts, and applies the global backup schedule and default backup policy

purpose: Verify that a SysAdmin is prohibited from defining or modifying institution-wide global backup schedules and default backup policies
preconditions: SysAdmin is authenticated (authorized only for local/dataset schedules)
action_or_input: SysAdmin attempts to define or modify institution-wide global backup schedules or default backup policies
expected_result: BADMS denies the global backup configuration action

purpose: Verify that IT Security is prohibited from defining or modifying institution-wide global backup schedules and default backup policies
preconditions: IT Security member is authenticated (authorized for security/encryption/RBAC policies, not global backup schedules)
action_or_input: IT Security member attempts to define or modify institution-wide global backup schedules or default backup policies
expected_result: BADMS denies the global backup configuration action

purpose: Verify that an authorized actor can view protected information (audit logs, request status, backup status, reports) matching their authorized scope
preconditions: Actor is authenticated and holds authorization for the requested information scope (e.g., SysAdmin for audit/activity history; User for own requests)
action_or_input: Actor requests access to protected information within their authorized scope
expected_result: BADMS authorizes and displays the protected information

purpose: Verify that a HoD is prohibited from accessing protected reports or request status outside the HoD's own department
preconditions: HoD of Department A is authenticated
action_or_input: Department A HoD attempts to view protected reports or request status belonging to Department B
expected_result: BADMS denies access and does not display information outside the HoD's department scope

purpose: Verify that a user is prohibited from viewing request status or history belonging to another user
preconditions: User A is authenticated; a request was submitted by User B
action_or_input: User A attempts to access or track the status of User B's request
expected_result: BADMS denies access and does not disclose User B's request status

purpose: Verify that an unauthorized actor is denied access to system audit logs
preconditions: Actor without audit log review authorization (e.g., standard User or HoD) is authenticated
action_or_input: Unauthorized actor attempts to view system audit logs
expected_result: BADMS denies access to the audit logs

purpose: Verify that an authorized IT Security Team member can manage RBAC permissions and configure/enforce security policies
preconditions: Actor is authenticated with the IT Security role
action_or_input: IT Security Team member submits changes to RBAC permissions or security policies
expected_result: BADMS validates and applies the RBAC permission updates and enforces the security policies

purpose: Verify that a non-IT Security actor (e.g., SysAdmin, Super Admin, HoD, or User) is prohibited from managing RBAC permissions
preconditions: Actor is authenticated with a role other than IT Security (e.g., SysAdmin or Super Admin)
action_or_input: Non-IT Security actor attempts to modify RBAC permissions
expected_result: BADMS denies the RBAC management action

purpose: Verify that a non-IT Security actor is prohibited from configuring or modifying security policies assigned to IT Security
preconditions: Actor is authenticated with a role other than IT Security
action_or_input: Non-IT Security actor attempts to configure or modify IT security policies
expected_result: BADMS denies the security policy configuration action
